tonight.headline: Down 31.5 before a snap: Minnesota raised two receivers and still have not ruled on Jefferson
body: Bad news first. Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison are both still questionable at 18:30 Eastern on Saturday, and Minnesota elevated two receivers from the practice squad this afternoon, Odell Beckham Jr. and Jeshaun Jones. Neither starter was downgraded, but a team does not raise two receivers when it is sure of both. Kyle Monangai is out, in a boot, and was not put on injured reserve. You are 0–4 and 31.5 behind on Bucky Irving's Thursday night; ESPN has you at 45%, 122.1 against 130.8, the same as this morning.

Nothing needs doing today. No status on your fourteen changed. Two things moved around them: Pittsburgh raised a running back, which reads as Rico Dowdle sitting and Jaylen Warren keeping the backfield, and Stefon Diggs was dropped by Bok-aneers and sits on waivers until Wednesday. Tomorrow's brief is written at 07:00, before the 09:30 inactive lists, so the two cards below are still yours to fire.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Irving's 31.5 is banked (archive). Ja'Marr Chase, 21.8, is still on their bench and still questionable: no report of a concussion clearance had been published by 18:30 Eastern, and Cincinnati elevated only a safety. Kendre Miller, 7.9, is in their flex. If Chase is cleared and they put him back, their 130.8 rises by about fourteen. McBride 18.8, Purdy 18.0, London 16.1; Marvin Harrison Jr.'s pending trade takes a receiver away from McBride's quarterback.

case.label: Your side
case.body: As set: Allen 20.1, Jefferson 18.6, Wilson 14.8, Warren 14.5, Tuten 14.0, Likely 12.9, Gordon 10.9, Fairbairn 8.5, the Vikings 7.8. None has played. Jefferson is the one questionable starter. Every number is the same as this morning's.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Sunday 09:30 Mexico City: the inactive lists for Jefferson, Addison, McLaurin, Dowdle and Chase. Nothing published on Saturday settles any of them.

case.body: As set you project 122.1; the projection lineup is 124.0. The whole 1.9 is McLaurin over Gordon in the flex, and the tool labels it COIN FLIP. Both numbers are the same in this afternoon's snapshot as this morning's. The rule for a coin flip is to take the projection and write nothing more.

case.label: What the reports say
case.body: He practised on Friday, limited, after sitting out Wednesday and Thursday; Dan Quinn said he looked good. The newest insider word is Friday night's: ESPN's Jeremy Fowler has him 'most likely' a game-time decision (NBC Sports, 9 Oct 23:55 UTC). On Saturday Washington elevated receiver Van Jefferson and safety Darren Hall and made no injured-reserve move (commanders.com, 15:59). Stefon Diggs is out and Jayden Daniels starts. The National Weather Service has rain all but certain at Landover, an inch or so, with gusts to 28 mph.

case.body: One limited practice in eight days on a hamstring, a game-time decision, and a wet, windy field. McLaurin and Gordon both play at 11:00, so nothing is lost by making the swap at 09:30, and a swap made today is one you must remember to undo. Sunday's brief is written before the list, so this one is yours to fire.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · two receivers elevated, no decision published · inactives Sun 09:30 Mexico City · kickoff 11:00
doFirst.title: If Jefferson is inactive: Addison, then McLaurin
doFirst.subtitle: Both Vikings receivers are still questionable and Minnesota elevated Odell Beckham Jr. and Jeshaun Jones this afternoon. Do nothing now; the order is set here so Sunday is a checklist.

case.label: Where it stands
case.body: Jefferson was limited all three days and is questionable; Addison was limited twice and is questionable (vikings.com). At 15:30 on Saturday Minnesota elevated two receivers, Beckham and Jones (vikings.com). PFT, 15:16 Eastern: 'Neither has been downgraded from questionable to out.' ESPN's Kevin Seifert: Jefferson's availability 'has yet to be determined'. Fowler on Friday night: Jefferson plans to play and the team wanted to see how he felt on Saturday; no result of that was published. Two elevations suggest doubt about at least one of them. That is my reading, not a report, and one writer thinks Addison is the likelier to sit.

case.label: The order
case.body: Addison, 11.4, is the tool's fallback and plays in the same game, but he is questionable too. If both are inactive, McLaurin, 12.8, takes the receiver slot if he is active and Gordon stays in the flex. All of them kick off at 11:00, so one look at 09:30 settles it.

case.label: If all three sit
case.body: Then you have no healthy receiver for the slot and the free add is Romeo Doubs, 12.2, for Monangai, who is out and in a walking boot. New England play at 11:00 too. Mack Hollins went on injured reserve today, so Doubs's larger share is at least four games long, but he is still one of four New England receivers sharing that work. It takes three inactives to get there; it is written down so you are not working it out at 09:35.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Jefferson is active and Addison outscores him on Sunday (archive). If Jefferson is inactive this card fires and the open lineup thesis closes untested.

whatWentWrong.title: Monangai is out, in a boot, with no return date
whatWentWrong.lead: Turf toe, a boot and a specialist. Chicago did not put him on injured reserve today, and nothing published sounds like one week.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Ruled out on Friday without a practice all week. Ben Johnson's Friday words were that he will not play and 'we'll see how long that injury sidelines him'. On Saturday Chicago elevated running back Zavier Scott and made no injured-reserve move; SI's Bears page says he is not an injured-reserve candidate and that the turf toe could cost multiple weeks, and relays ESPN's Courtney Cronin calling him week-to-week. D'Andre Swift has no designation.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: No lineup move: he was on your bench and ESPN projects 0.0. It makes his the seat that opens first, which is why the second card's last resort names him as the drop.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A return to practice next week keeps him. A move to injured reserve or a second missed game makes him the drop for Tuesday's claims, when you also need a defence for Minnesota's bye.

whatWentWrong.title: Both Vikings receivers are still questionable, and Minnesota elevated two more
whatWentWrong.lead: No decision by 18:30 Eastern on Saturday. Beckham and Jeshaun Jones came up from the practice squad. Your fallback for one is the other.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Jefferson limited three days, Addison two; both questionable and neither downgraded (PFT, 10 Oct 15:16 ET). Minnesota elevated Odell Beckham Jr. and Jeshaun Jones and activated centre Michael Jurgens from injured reserve (vikings.com, 15:30). Kevin O'Connell said on Friday that Beckham's use depends 'on how we see Sunday'. Left tackle Christian Darrisaw is out and right tackle Brian O'Neill questionable.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The second card's order: Addison first, McLaurin second. It is also why McLaurin's own status matters twice.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: An insider report tonight that either will or will not play. Either way the swap is made from the inactive list at 09:30 on Sunday, after tomorrow's brief.

worthALook.name: Romeo Doubs
worthALook.lead: Free, and Hollins went on injured reserve today, so the vacancy is at least four games long. He is still one of four receivers sharing it. The seat he would take is Monangai's.

case.label: The role
case.body: New England put Mack Hollins (calf) on injured reserve on Saturday, out at least four games (patriots.com, 10 Oct 16:00). In the game Hollins left, Doubs drew 9 targets and scored twice, 23.8 (archive); targets 3, 4, 4, 9. The team's site lists the available receivers as Doubs, DeMario Douglas, Efton Chism III and Kyle Williams and expects Doubs as a base receiver; its Friday analysis said Chism took Hollins's outside role. Las Vegas are without receivers Jalen Nailor and Dont'e Thornton and may be without Ashton Jeanty.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 12.2, behind McLaurin's 12.8 and only 1.3 above Gordon, so he does not clearly start this week. This morning's worry that the role 'may last one more game' is corrected: Hollins is gone for four. What still caps it is A.J. Brown, who is eligible to return in Week 6, was 'spotted in the Patriots locker room this week as he begins ramping up' (patriots.com) and was not activated today.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Monangai missing Week 6, which now looks likely, makes this Tuesday's decision alongside Diggs; or Jefferson, Addison and McLaurin all inactive on Sunday, which makes him a starter that morning. He is a free agent, so waiting costs no priority, only the risk a rival adds him.

If Monangai is still in a boot and Diggs has a practice target for Week 6, when Jefferson, Addison and Gordon are all on bye, this becomes a card. If not, it does not.
